h1.cap: Luck controls half your life. The other half... is yours.

q1.cap: Machiavelli wrote... "Fortune is the arbiter of one-half of our actions, but... she still leaves us to direct the other half, or perhaps a little less."

n6.cap: He compared fortune to a raging river. In calm weather... build your barriers.

q2.cap: "The cautious man, when it is time to turn adventurous, does not know how to do it."

n8.cap: The habit that won yesterday... can sink you tomorrow. So change with the river.
